prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: Down-weighting each net's cut probability by 1/log(1+k) (fan-out-aware cut weight) so huge clock/reset nets stop dominating the cut gradient and the objective instead optimises the many small-signal nets that carry most TNS violations.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=-0.034 robust(mean-std)=-0.021 min_case=-0.024 seed_std=0.034 tns_mean=-0.004 all_valid=True
  C1: score=-0.001 dWNS=+2.3% dTNS=-1.6% per-seed=[-0.03 +0.00 +0.03]
  C2: score=-0.009 dWNS=-3.7% dTNS=+0.5% per-seed=[+0.02 -0.05 +0.00]
  C3: score=-0.024 dWNS=-4.3% dTNS=-0.2% per-seed=[+0.00 +0.02 -0.09]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->138, wcut 421->423, crit_cross 0.011->0.011, repair_flips 103->103, changed-vs-baseline 1.1%
  C2: cut 318->318, wcut 1007->1006, crit_cross 0.000->0.000, repair_flips 238->237, changed-vs-baseline 1.6%
  C3: cut 582->571, wcut 1955->1926, crit_cross 0.069->0.084, repair_flips 353->353, changed-vs-baseline 1.8%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response: (1) No — hypothesis not supported: total −3.4%, robust −2.1%, TNS −0.4%; down-weighting large nets did not improve small-signal TNS. (2) C3 drove the loss (score −2.4%, dWNS −4.3%) despite fewer cut/wcut nets (582→571, 1955→1926) and unchanged repair flips (353); critically, crit_cross rose 0.069→0.084, so fewer cuts but more critical-pair crossings — the mechanism backfired. C1/C2 essentially flat. (3) Seed spread is high (std 0.034; C3 per-seed −0.09 to +0.02), exceeding the mean effect — not acceptable. (4) Next: gate the 1/log(1+k) weight to non-critical nets only, or add a crit_cross penalty term, and re-run with more seeds.
